findings.summary: The provider-only scaffold state has no explicit workflow disposition.
findings.evidence: Track 5 step 2 explicitly handles neither HAR existing, an existing business HAR with an optional absent provider, and an existing business HAR with a required absent provider, but it does not state what to do when the provider HAR exists and the business HAR is absent. Track 4 refuses initialization when either target already exists, so the pair initializer cannot resolve that state. The Skill and HMOS-EVAL-11 repeat the same branch set. The 'initialize only when neither HAR exists' guard prevents unsafe initialization, but the workflow should explicitly classify the provider-only state as blocked or route it to an authorized recovery procedure so execution and evaluation do not depend on inference.
